verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop OS, so built-in screen readers and accessibility tooling is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions a screen reader, magnifier, or accessibility setup during install. AI dictation (Voxtype) and OCR text extraction exist, but they are adjacent productivity features, not documented accessibility tools for getting started with the OS.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use built-in screen readers and accessibility tools to get started with the OS
